WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points FROM race_totals
),
above AS (
  SELECT rt.name, rt.total_points
  FROM race_totals rt, avg_total a
  WHERE rt.total_points > a.avg_points
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above) AS combined_total_points,
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL))
     FROM results res
     JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM above)) AS avg_laps,
  (SELECT AVG(ab.total_points - a.avg_points)
     FROM above ab, avg_total a) AS avg_excess_over_average_total;
